title: Interactive Biology Diagramming
description: Interactive Biology Diagramming - Generate biology diagrams, label structures, complete drag-and-drop labeling exercises for visual biology learning.

userStories.title: Add diagram_attempts table to database
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a database table to store student diagram attempt data.
acceptanceCriteria: Add diagram_attempts model with fields: user_id, topic, score, difficulty, completed_at
Run migration successfully
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Extended with labels JSON, completed bool, started_at fields. Schema uses Base.metadata.create_all (no manual migration). Created src/schemas/diagram.py alongside.

userStories.title: Create diagram generation API endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a POST /diagram/generate endpoint that returns a diagram with labels and metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /diagram/generate accepts prompt and topic parameters
Returns diagram, labels, and metadata in response
Supported topics: cells, organ systems, genetics, anatomy
Integrates with AI image generation or SVG rendering
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented: DiagramAgent generates SVG diagrams via LLM. POST /diagram/generate endpoint accepts prompt, topic, difficulty. Returns diagram_svg, labels array, title, metadata. Files: src/agents/diagram.py, src/api/diagram.py, src/schemas/diagram.py, src/main.py.

userStories.title: Create diagram validation API endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a POST /diagram/validate endpoint that scores labels and returns corrections with explanations.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /diagram/validate accepts label submissions
Returns score, corrections, and explanations
Structure matching and label correctness scoring implemented
Saves attempt record to diagram_attempts table
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implementated: POST /diagram/validate endpoint with algorithmic label matching. validate_labels() function in src/agents/diagram.py does case-insensitive, whitespace-trimmed comparison. Endpoint saves DiagramAttempt with score and results. Files: src/schemas/diagram.py, src/agents/diagram.py, src/api/diagram.py, tests/test_agents.py, tests/test_api.py.

userStories.title: Build diagram request UI
userStories.description: As a student, I want to request biology diagrams by topic so that I can study visually.
acceptanceCriteria: Prompt input field for requesting diagrams
Topic selector: cells, organ systems, genetics, anatomy
Difficulty selector: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced
Generated diagram displayed with annotation overlay
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using Playwright browser tools

userStories.title: Build interactive labeling UI
userStories.description: As a student, I want to drag-and-drop or select labels on a diagram so that I can test my visual understanding.
acceptanceCriteria: Labels are draggable or selectable on the diagram
Submit button sends labels for validation
Correctness feedback displayed per label
Validation results shown inline on the diagram
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using Playwright browser tools

userStories.title: Build diagram explanation feedback UI
userStories.description: As a student, I want explanations for incorrect labels so that I can learn from my mistakes.
acceptanceCriteria: Incorrect labels are highlighted with explanations
Explanations generated based on correct answer
Retry button allows re-labeling incorrect items
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using Playwright browser tools

userStories.title: Add difficulty level selector to diagram system
userStories.description: As a student, I want diagrams at different difficulty levels so that learning adapts to my ability.
acceptanceCriteria: Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced modes functional
Label quantity increases with difficulty
Difficulty selection persisted in diagram_attempts table
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using Playwright browser tools
